observations: Photo 0: Nikon DSLR camera with a 70-300mm lens, placed on a box labeled 'McSteve'. The camera body is black with visible wear, especially on the grip area. The lens has 'Nikon AF-S DX' and '70-300mm 1:4G ED' engraved on the barrel.

Photo 1: Same camera and lens from a slightly different angle, showing the top of the camera with mode dial and shutter count indicator. The lens barrel has 'Nikon DX 70-300mm 1:4G ED' visible. The camera body shows signs of use, including scuffs and dirt on the grip.
Photo 2: Side view of the camera, showing the left side with a worn and dirty grip area. The camera body has visible scratches and discoloration. The lens appears clean and undamaged.
All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI MCSTEVE'.
